title: The Final Static
author: Cyrus Amberdale
blurb: Astrid Coldharbour, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
